description: The strike bank — EMPTY. In piece #5 this held the composer's own recorded piano strikes, the seed of that piece's opening. This piece has no piano and no recording yet; the drawer and tools/strike_db.js read this file and work from an empty bank.
_provenance: Skeleton written by the port from piece #6 (septet_LGMF_2026 @ 0d70fda), 2026-10-04 — the new-piece protocol's 3.4. The strike bank is EMPTY, as it was there; the shape is piece #5's. Recorded strikes are a piece's own.
